in_marathi.name: Rangitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rangitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rangitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'rang' meaning 'color'. It is a name given to a girl who is as colorful and artful as the world around her. It is believed that Rangitha is blessed with creativity and artistic skills.
